question.text: Calculation of NAV must be INDEPENDENT of what function?

answer.text: Fund management function of the AIF

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that NAV calculation should be independent from the fund management function of the AIF and disclosed to investors, to avoid any conflict in valuation. The Trap: Trustee, sales and distribution functions are separate governance/commercial roles and are not the specific function the workbook requires NAV calculation to be independent of. Note: Based on Series-XIX-B workbook p.144, which sets out the NAV-independence requirement.
